title: agent.cli.correction v1
description: What argshape (adapters/argshape/) learned or changed about how an agent called a CLI or database. Published by its Claude Code Bash hooks: the first time a binary build rejects a token (rejection), each time a known-bad token is rewritten before a command runs (correction), when a fix is withdrawn because it failed or the agent opted out (demotion), and when the circuit breaker drops corrections to advice (breaker). Consumers (reflex-recorder, dashboards) measure whether corrections cut repeated failures. Carries tokens and binary names only; never command output or row values.

bin.description: Binary name, plus subcommand context when known (e.g. 'gh pr')

ctx.description: Subcommand path the token was rejected under

good.description: The replacement, empty when none is known
